title: Madagascar: Invasive Rats Are Stopping Small Mammals From Returning to Madagascar's Regenerating Forests - Study
content: In south-eastern Madagascar, patches of forest that were once cut down to make way for farms are slowly naturally regenerating after being left to lie fallow. label: adverse
max_acceptable_basis: p90 of 2264 scored nature_recovery articles in filtered_20260804_131029 (median 0.2383, p99 1.5226)
why_adverse: Trajectory framing rather than subject matter: the vocabulary is ecology and the finding is that recovery is being BLOCKED. The forests are regenerating; the small mammals are not returning. recovery_evidence 4.92 is the error stated in one number — the dimension that should have registered the ABSENCE of recovery instead registered the presence of recovery vocabulary. human_agency 6.79 scored highest of the six, reading a researchers' trapping study as agency. The headline is adversarial at the token level: 'Returning' and 'Regenerating Forests' both appear literally, and both describe something that is not happening, negated structurally across clauses rather than lexically, so a scorer keyed on domain vocabulary has almost no signal to work against. CAVEAT, and it should travel with this row: do NOT treat the magnitude as clean evidence for the decline-framing hard-negative work (llm-distillery#60) without checking the scale first. This batch's raw distribution is collapsed against zero — median 0.2383, p90 0.6414, p99 1.5226 — which is the raw-scale-collapse signature under investigation in llm-distillery#75/#76. The LABEL holds regardless (this should not have scored high in nature_recovery); the apparent 3.4x-over-p99 does not, because the normalization producing that p99 is itself suspect.
misleading_features: heavy ecology and conservation vocabulary (regenerating forests, small mammals, lemurs, trap nights)
'Returning' and 'Regenerating Forests' as literal headline tokens, both negated across clauses
a quantified threshold finding (3.3 black rats per 100 trap nights) reading as measurable_outcomes
researcher-intervention framing reading as human_agency (6.79, the top dimension)
peer-reviewed study framing carrying general scientific credibility into a lens-fit judgement
